redRegression.scope: Old native API lacks canonical metadata, stale same-action mount binding and mixed-success guard; four more boundary tests added afterwards.

apiAndLegacyFocused.scope: HTTP dispatcher, not independent socket/BFF; legacy split/combined/open, domain and eight new metadata/race checks. Latest code including bounded lock and updated strict runtime-capability expectation.

ownedPostgres.scope: Real disposable PostgreSQL17, native HTTP dispatcher with existing setup fixtures and independent actual storage adapters; remount/restart/concurrent narrowing/stale binding/rollback/100ms and 1s lock limits plus existing Session/Controller/Effect atomic receipt/current Task authorization. Not independent native server/BFF/Worker/browser E2E.

makeTest.skipBoundary: Inherited environment/dependency conditions plus six new PostgreSQL cases; all six separately exercised with zero skips in ownedPostgres.

sourceFreeze.selection: Tracked/new Python/TypeScript/JS and JSON/TOML/YAML/lock/Makefile sources before final full suite; generated evals/reports excluded.

legacyPreservation.scope: Byte-identical old SDK, old public contracts and280Coverage source/test files against published base; no fresh SDK browser recertification claimed.

priorWholeSuite.reason: Existing strict runtime-capabilities equality expectation omitted new additive metadata field; updated that one expectation, production code unchanged, final whole suite rerun.

firstOwnedPostgres.reason: New active Session check initially rejected existing low-level registry-only historical bindings; compatibility restored without allowing public unauthenticated admission.

earlierOwnedPostgres.scope: Before adding bounded/shorter-operator lock tests; final62 supersedes it.

priorAttempts.reason: Explicitly interrupted owned pytest for added mount-before-bind race, then newly identified split-route lock wait bound; not successful whole-suite proof. Initial Ruff/mypy import/type errors fixed before passing gates.

boundaries.activeBindingUpdate: Only explicit rebind updates existing current row; no new all-revision history storage
boundaries.responseGuarantee: Current observed facts. Mount/binding/lease separate commits; unknown response may have committed; no automatic credential replay/cross-request linearizability or immediate revocation claim.
